title: Bureau M2 context packet input
description: Public Context Packet request contract. Runtime checks additionally enforce URL parsing, valid dates, canonical size and defensive secret scanning.

content.description: Non-array JSON object. Canonical serialization must be at most 10000 characters; the implementation also applies its secret scan.

uuidv4.description: Lowercase UUIDv4 as required by the candidate validator.

items.description: HTTPS URL without username or password; the service does not fetch it.

anyOf.description: UTC timestamp spelling with a four-digit year and optional exactly three fractional digits. For new publication input, the server additionally requires a literal Gregorian date, hours 00-23 and minutes/seconds 00-59; impossible dates, rollovers and leap seconds are rejected. This shared input/read schema retains the lexical profile so previously stored Packets remain representable; use the offline input checker for the stricter publication rule.

x-bureau-runtime-checks: Canonical content serialization is at most 10000 characters.
New publication observed_at values must identify a literal Gregorian UTC date/time; the shared schema's lexical pattern alone does not check calendar validity.
Defensive secret scanning rejects likely private keys, bearer credentials, and credential-like fields.
